learning_outcomes.text: Profile a messy dataset to find duplicates, blanks and type errors before cleaning
Apply Power Query transformations to clean and reshape data reproducibly
Use Remove Duplicates and Table.Distinct understanding their case-sensitivity and ordering caveats
Reconcile two datasets and explain the residual differences
Review AI-suggested cleaning steps before accepting them into a query

integrative_case: An analyst receives two overlapping customer exports full of duplicates and inconsistent labels: profile both, clean them with a reproducible Power Query, de-duplicate with the correct case handling, reconcile the two into one master list, and document every AI-suggested step that was accepted or rejected.
